# FRAM School

> A Cambridge primary school and kindergarten in Sibiu, Romania, for children aged 3 to 11. Founded 2014. Habermann Learning Campus, Berăriei 4, Sibiu.

FRAM is a fully accredited Cambridge International School and a Romanian-recognised school, teaching the Cambridge Primary Curriculum alongside the Romanian national line in two parallel study lines. The school is built on three pillars (Academic, Welfare & Pastoral, Skills & Events) and seven values (Kindness, Curiosity, Awareness, Leadership, Fairness, Resilience, Respect).

## Key facts

- **Location**: Habermann Learning Campus, Berăriei 4, Sibiu, Romania
- **Founded**: 2014 (Kindergarten); Primary school opened 2022
- **Ages**: 3–11 (Kindergarten through Y6 / Pre-Primary through Grade IV)
- **Curriculum**: Cambridge Primary + Romanian National Curriculum
- **School day**: 8:00 drop-off, 9:00 lessons, 3:15 mandatory end, 3:30–4:15 Houses & Clubs
- **Phone**: +40 724 491 440
- **General email**: office@framschool.com
- **Admissions**: admissions@framschool.com
- **Safeguarding (DSL)**: safeguarding@framschool.com (Marieluise Knobloch)
- **Vacancies**: contact@framschool.com

## Senior leadership (5 people)

- Ileana Vrânceanu — Founder & CEO
- Tiberiu Popescu — Headmaster
- Simona Dică — Head of Academics (Academic Pillar)
- Marieluise Knobloch — Head of Welfare & Pastoral, Designated Safeguarding Lead
- Raluca Cardoș — Head of Skills & Events Pillar

## The Four Houses

FRAM children are sorted into one of four Houses, each named after a famous explorer:

- House Alexandra David-Néel — Purple, Earth, Tiger, House of the Givers (French heritage)
- House Fernando Magellan — Turquoise, Water, Peacock, House of Awareness (Portuguese heritage)
- House Amelia Earhart — Yellow, Air, Swan / Lion, House of Courage (UK heritage)
- House Neil Armstrong — Magenta, Fire, Wolf, House of Friendship (American heritage)
